terms.gloss: jackfruit: the tree that bears it (the botanical name)
terms.comment: The botanists’ name, labelled modern: Artocarpus, “bread-fruit” in Greek, is the genus of the jackfruit and the breadfruit. The fruit is pōmum Artocarpī. No reference work we searched (Traupman, Morgan–Owens, Levi–Bini) has a name for it.

phrases.latin: Hoc pōmum Artocarpī tam grave est quam tū!
phrases.english: This jackfruit is as heavy as you are!

phrases.latin: Pōmum Artocarpī ingēns est: vix id tollere possum.
phrases.english: The jackfruit is huge: I can hardly lift it.
